name: YouTube
summary: Reads your YouTube channel's subscribers, views and newest videos every 6 hours.

settings.label: Channel ID (starts with UC) from youtube.com/account_advanced
API key from Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → Create credentials → API key (turn on "YouTube Data API v3" in the Library first)
Or a Google sign-in file (JSON with client_id, client_secret and refresh_token) instead of an API key
